Required moving resources for Q10, Q11, Q17, Q20, Q29 and Q34, the Q22 sound, and the headset test audio are absent; the actual PDF still frames are retained. Article/photo source citations do not establish original movie or sound bytes.
The separate answer sheet and evaluation questionnaire mentioned in the instructions are not obtained. No blank form or media is invented.
